title: Therapy Homework Completion Rate
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=therapy:homework
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(status="complete")) as successful by _time theme
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for therapy homework assignments by theme.
value: Completion rate shows whether the work between sessions is really happening instead of staying aspirational.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for therapy homework assignments events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for therapy homework assignments by theme.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often therapy homework assignments works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
